title: Correction of Randolph's birth date and end of proceedings
summary: DeMichael's note that Randolph asked to correct Chilton's listing to January 28, 1899.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: After the interview, Mr. Randolph asked me to correct birth date, as listed in Chilton's Who's Who in Jazz. It is listed as July 28, 1899. He says the correct date is January 28, 1899.
